seeded.note: Candidates seeded from a research agent's web-search summaries (see data/leads); unverified until the contest file cites the Secretary of State certified list. Jones: the major (Economics and International Studies) is from a Prediction Edge profile only and is not included. The American Dream Institute's founding year is given as both 2024 and 2025. His age is reported as 34 or 35. He moved to Napa in 2021, per news.
